This '''hideout''' was used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] '''[[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]]''' when he went into hiding on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

==History==
[[File:RoboninosHideoutDestroyed-HuntingTheHuntersPartII.png|thumb|left|200px|Robonino's hideout is destroyed]]

After completing a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] imprisonment, the members of Cad Bane's posse went their separate ways to hide out. Robonino fled to Rodia and made use of an abandoned [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] base in the remote swamplands to disguise his underwater hideout. He had an elaborate defensive system in place to cover both attack by land and under water. Beneath the swampy surface he installed [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]]-triggered [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] and on the ground he reprogrammed [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to explode when intruders were detected.

At the behest of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] led a team of [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA troopers]] to investigate reports of suspected [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity near the abandoned base. When Robonino's defenses were activated, Robonino attempted to escape amidst the commotion. Fisto caught sight of him and was met with blaster fire and several [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] thrown at him. Fisto used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|redirect]] the detonators into the hideout, destroying it in the ensuing explosion.
